offers.scope: Draft a single clear, consistent "Standard Service" description document for the repair business: what is included/excluded, typical turnaround, and pricing basis, resolving conflicting public descriptions. Includes a short FAQ addressing the top repeat customer questions, ready to publish on website/social pages.

Analyze the producer's inventory data to identify: (1) frequently shorted low-cost components with recommended reorder points/quantities, (2) excess/slow-moving parts with recommended action (reduce, liquidate, repurpose), and (3) a simple ongoing reorder-trigger rule set. Delivered as a concise written report using the data the customer supplies.

Create a clear cost-and-feature comparison document for the professional practice's software subscription options: side-by-side pricing, key features, and a recommendation based on stated needs. Delivered as a ready-to-use written report.

Create a simple supplier price and lead-time tracking template plus a short written analysis of current supplier data provided: which suppliers/materials show rising prices or lengthening lead times, and recommended actions (renegotiate, diversify, stock buffer). Delivered as a ready-to-use written report plus a reusable tracking sheet structure.
